lines.1: 「Oh, those two are looking awfully cozy again. All right, interrogation time!」
lines.2: 「Now then, you two. You've been getting pretty close lately. Are you dating or what?」
lines.6: 「There's no need to keep it a secret anymore.」
lines.8: 「So I hit the nail on the head.」
lines.11: 「The whole side of the room by the hall is packed with gawkers now.」
lines.12: 「Doesn't seeing happy people kind of tick you off?」
lines.13: 「Don't ask me to agree with you.」
lines.14: 「I wanna get all lovey-dovey with someone too... Then call all that 'love.'」
lines.15: 「You really are honest, I'll give you that.」
lines.16: And just as the commotion over the new couple was dying down, everyone noticed one thing.
